Hi, our return and refund policy is:

Items can be returned within 14 days of receipt for a refund to the original payment method.
Returns made between 14 and 28 days from receipt can only be exchanged or given store credit.
Returned items must be unworn, unwashed, in original resalable condition, and include original tags and packaging.
Refunds are processed after the return is received and inspected, and if approved they usually appear in your account within 5 working days.
Original shipping charges are non-refundable.

A few exceptions apply:

Sale items are final sale for cash refunds. Instead, a gift card is provided for the same value. If a sale item is defective, damaged, or the wrong size, it may be exchanged for the same item.
Mystery box items are non-refundable, but they may be exchanged for a different size.
For international returns, return postage is paid by the customer, and non-EU international orders are refund or credit only, not exchanges.

For UK returns and exchanges, you can use the returns information here: https://amicci.com/apps/returns
